notes: Proof fixture for the rebuild-pixel-diff comparison mode. Rebuilds the example.com capture via the astro target, runs npm install + npm run build, boots a static server on both the original clone and the rebuilt dist, screenshots at the desktop viewport, and pixel-diffs. Passes when diffRatio is within 1 minus parity_threshold (0.01). Slow path: ~85 seconds per run including npm install.
